newsitem.title: UK: Leeds sees good demand, promising outlook.
newsitem.headline: Leeds sees good demand, promising outlook.

text.p: UK textiles firm Leeds Group Plc said on Tuesday that its new financial year had so far been good with demand for textiles in the UK offsetting the damage inflicted on exports by a stronger pound.
The outlook for the group was promising, he said.
"The improvement in the UK housing market has increased demand for household textiles...," Robert Wade, chairman of Leeds Group Plc told shareholders at its annual general meeting.
Wade said the company's yarn dyeing division has made a strong start to the year. "...And this appears well set to continue," he said.
